profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I have taken several projects from the idea stage all the way to finished software solutions. In each project, I have collected and analyzed the requirements. Then discussed possible solutions, timelines, costs and trade-offs with stakeholders. Then designed and developed the database, API, and UI. Presented progress to stakeholders regularly. Provided training to users and conducted pilots when development was done. Finally, collected feedback and made necessary changes.

I have been doing this for 11 years, and I can confidently say that I have gotten very good at it. I have learned to develop software that is user-friendly, robust, reliable and secure, and low-maintenance.
